conventions.convention: Indices start at zero; Toeplitz entries are T_ij=t_(i-j), circulant entries are c_((i-j) mod N), and Hermitian lags satisfy t_(-r)=conjugate(t_r). J reverses coordinates, including the empty vector.
The canonical DFT has negative exponent and normalization N^(-1/2); D_N=√N F_N is unnormalised. Cyclic convolution is unnormalised, so its unitary transform law carries √N.
Z is the lower shift and the Stein displacement is A−ZAZ*. A width-r generator means A−ZAZ*=GH*, with G,H having r columns.

Residual evaluation rounds products, accumulates each row left to right, then rounds b−p componentwise. Exact operation results must be zero or normal, and (s+1)u<1. Complex systems use the explicit realification of dimension 2n.
The general-RHS procedure uses exact arithmetic and rejects nonpositive reflection pivots before division. HPD inputs guarantee positive pivots; no finite-precision stability assertion is made.

load_bearing.statement: For Hermitian positive-definite T_n, the displayed recursion has strictly positive denominators and satisfies T_k φ_k=g_k and ν_k=t_0−g_k*φ_k>0 for 0≤k<n. Computing through order n−1 takes O(n²) complex arithmetic operations and O(n) working storage.

For Hermitian positive-definite T_n and arbitrary b∈C^n, the specified exact-arithmetic algorithm returns T_n^(-1)b. With u=T_n^(-1)e_0 and v=T_n^(-1)e_(n−1), T_n^(-1)=[L(u)L(u)*−L(Z_nv)L(Z_nv)*]/u_0, where u_0>0. Work is O(n²) and storage is O(n).

C(c)=F_N^(-1)diag(λ)F_N, where λ_k=Σ_j c_j exp(−2πikj/N). Invertibility is equivalent to every λ_k being nonzero; solvability requires and suffices that the transformed right-hand side vanish at every zero mode.

For m,n≥1, the specified embedding at the least power-of-two length N≥m+n−1 makes the first m coordinates of c*_N x̃ equal Tx in exact arithmetic. Three exact DFT calls give O(N log₂N) arithmetic for N≥2 and constant work for N=1.
Given A−Z_nAZ_n*=GH* with width s≥1 and nonzero leading scalar pivot d, the specified G′,H′ satisfy S−Z_(n−1)SZ_(n−1)*=G′H′* for S=M−ℓd^(-1)r*. The updated displacement rank is at most s.

concerns.concern: The Statement says “For complex $A,x,b\in\mathbb C^n$”, but A must be an n×n matrix for the subsequent realification and matrix products. The surrounding formulas make the intended type clear.

The Statement allows n=1, but proof step 2.3 unconditionally says “For $k=0$, the formula gives $\alpha_1=t_1/t_0$ and $\phi_1=(\alpha_1)$”. At n=1, t_1 is outside the supplied lags and there is no update. The n=1 conclusion follows immediately from step 2.2; step 2.3 needs qualification to the case n≥2.
